title: Many Cultures, One City
text:
Many people live in cities with different cultures. In my city, people speak many languages. Some families cook food from their home countries. Children learn new words from their friends at school.

Cultural diversity makes our lives more interesting. We can try new food, listen to new music and learn about other holidays. Some people think it is important to respect every culture. My friend from Japan teaches me how to make sushi.

questions.text: What does the writer's friend from Japan teach the writer?
What can we infer about the writer?
options: The writer does not like new things
The writer enjoys learning about other cultures
The writer lives in a place with no other cultures
The writer only eats food from their own country

questions.text: Why might a child learn new words from friends at school?
options: The friends come from different backgrounds
The teachers do not allow talking

vocabulary.definition: the ways of life, traditions and beliefs of a group of people
a range of different people, ideas or things
to show that you value someone or something
special days or periods when people do not work and celebrate

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas moram em cidades com culturas diferentes. Na minha cidade, as pessoas falam muitos idiomas. Algumas famílias cozinham comida dos seus países de origem. As crianças aprendem palavras novas com os amigos na escola.

A diversidade cultural torna nossas vidas mais interessantes. Podemos experimentar comidas novas, ouvir músicas novas e aprender sobre outros feriados. Algumas pessoas acham importante respeitar cada cultura. Meu amigo do Japão me ensina a fazer sushi.
